_readme: 8vc.com /team/ pages, fetched from the site's own sitemap.xml by scratch/site-pull.py. 51 rows, 1 unfetchable (brian-de-guzman). The list is keyed both as "rows" (what site-portfolio.py's file_list parser reads) and under its own name, so the file is readable either way.

rows.name: Adrienne Alexander
rows.bio: Adrienne supports a founding partner at 8VC. Prior to joining 8VC, Adrienne supported the co-head of the Endeavor Fund at Vista Equity Partners. Adrienne graduated from the University of Texas, receiving her B.A. in finance and her M.S. in clinical therapy.

rows.name: Alex Kolicich
rows.bio: Alex Kolicich focuses on IT and Bio-IT investments. Prior to joining 8VC, Alex was a Partner at Formation 8. Alex also worked with Peter Thiel as a Principal at Mithril Capital Management , a growth-stage venture fund, where he helped lead investments in AppDirect , C2FO and Helion Energy . Preceding his venture career, Alex worked as engineer and early-product advisor at Clarium , Palantir , and Google . He was an early member of the Clarium Capital quantitative engineering team (with Joe Lonsdale) and close advisor/collaborator with the early Palantir team; advising on product design and contributing to the product. At Google Research, Alex worked on Google Street-Views before and during launch. Preceding Street-Views, also at Google, he worked on the development and launch of the Google Checkout product.

rows.name: Alex McLane
rows.bio: Alex is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on AI application layer software and robotics. Prior to 8VC, Alex worked at the Yale Endowment and chaired a debating society for political and moral philosophy at Yale. He graduated magna cum laude from Yale with a Bachelor's in Math and Philosophy. Originally from Los Angeles, he spent much of his childhood in Hong Kong and Singapore.

rows.name: Alex Moore
rows.bio: Alex Moore runs Defense for 8VC and incubates companies through 8VC’s Build Program. Prior to joining 8VC Alex was a startup operator for 12 years. Alex was the 1st employee of Palantir Technologies. Alex currently sits on boards for Palantir, Saronic, Epirus, Chaos, Gallatin, CX2, iCOMAT and Terra.

rows.name: Asanka Jayasuriya
rows.bio: Asanka Jayasuriya is the CTO at 8VC. He is an accomplished engineering and product leader with 20+ years of experience in the cloud. He has a strong background in enterprise SaaS, PLG products, infrastructure, and security. Notably, he served as CTO and SVP of Engineering at SailPoint , leading their successful transition to the cloud and successful exit event. He also held senior leadership roles at InVision , Atlassian , and Amazon , driving growth, operational excellence, and innovation. At 8VC, Asanka works with the entrepreneurs and leaders in our portfolio as a virtual CTO supporting their growth.

rows.name: Audrey Abbott
rows.bio: Audrey is 8VC's Event Manager. She spearheads all internal and external events for the company. Her goal is to continue 8VC’s history of creating memorable high-profile events. Prior to joining 8VC, she worked in Events at the Texas Rangers Baseball Team and with the Jonas Brothers. Audrey graduated from the University of Southern California with a B.A. in Music Industry and a Political Science minor in 2020.

rows.name: Ava Eitzen
rows.bio: Ava is a member of 8VC's talent team. Prior to 8VC, Ava spent six years as an external recruiter for early stage startups, as well as organizations such as Palantir and Founders Fund . Ava received her Bachelors of Science from UC Davis . She is an active private pilot, and grew up in the U.S. Virgin Islands. She now lives in the San Francisco Bay Area.

rows.name: Bela Becerra
rows.bio: Bela Becerra is a member of the 8VC investment team, where she focuses on the firm's early-stage practice and build initiatives. She also partners with portfolio companies on talent and media strategy. She leads the Emerging Builders community to foster the next generation of the most ambitious entrepreneurs and engineers across SF, NY, and beyond. Bela holds a BA in Economics from Stanford University and is originally from Los Angeles.

rows.name: Caroline Haun
rows.bio: Caroline is Operations Director at 8VC. Prior to 8VC, Caroline managed operations for Formation 8. Prior to Formation 8, she worked at Highbridge Capital , in New York, as a Client Services professional specializing in loan-focused funds. Caroline began her career at San Francisco based hedge fund, PFM , L.P. as a research assistant focused on the Healthcare sector. Caroline received her B.S. in Business Administration with a concentration in Finance from The University of the Pacific .

rows.name: Damon Lim
rows.bio: As IT Director at 8VC, Damon enables friction-free productivity and best-in-class security through the application of technology and modern IT concepts and practices. Prior to 8VC, Damon led IT for 4 tech startups ( Palantir , Collective Health , Kandji , and Enkata) and was introduced to the venture space as Director of IT for Next47 . Damon is a graduate of San Francisco State University , where he received his bachelor’s degree in business administration.

rows.name: Denise Mendez
rows.bio: For the past three years, I was with SNH Capital Partners , a Private Equity firm, most recently as Office Manager. Aside from managing day-to-day operations, I supported cross functional teams from marketing, business development and real estate ensuring operational and service excellence. Prior to that, I have a strong background in luxury hospitality as well as food and beverage.

rows.name: Deny Khoung
rows.bio: Deny partners with 8VC's portfolio companies, adding value through design mentorship, hiring, product feedback, and being a conduit to help teams overcome design challenges. He also helps to drive the firm's design initiatives forward. Deny co-founded Standard Metrics , a financial collaboration platform for founders and their investors. Previously, Deny founded Whitespace, a designer accelerator helping early-stage startups ramp their design teams. Prior to that, he was a Designer-in-Residence at Formation 8 and a Creative Director at Zanbato , a fintech company focused on bringing efficiency to private capital markets. Deny has a BFA in Graphic Design and BFA in Photography from San Jose State University where he also served as an adjunct design lecturer. Deny serves as an advisor to startups including Standard Metrics, Affinity , and Esper .

rows.name: Drew Oetting
rows.bio: Drew is a founding partner of 8VC. He focuses on investments across various stage and sectors including vertical software, health delivery, and biomanufacturing. He is also a founding Board Director of Affinity Technologies, an early stage enterprise software company. Previously Drew was a partner at Formation 8. Before that he served as Chief of Staff to Joe Lonsdale. Drew serves on the Competitiveness Council for Cerberus Capital Management . He is also a Trustee of LivingOnOne , a non-profit impact production studio; WeAreThorn , a NGO which leverages technology to eliminate child trafficking; and the Claremont McKenna College Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship .

rows.name: Erica Sun
rows.bio: Erica Sun is the firm’s associate general counsel and provides guidance to the 8VC team on investments, exits, corporate governance and portfolio counseling. Prior to 8VC, Erica was a senior associate in Fenwick's San Francisco office, representing emerging companies from formation through exit and their investors, and advised on M&A transactions at Kirkland & Ellis. Erica received a J.D. from University of California, Berkeley, School of Law, and an A.B. in Neuroscience with High Honors from Dartmouth College.

rows.name: Evan Pun
rows.bio: Evan is a product designer and a 3D artist. He works with 8VC’s portfolio companies to design the next generation of products and brands. Prior to joining 8VC Evan was a staff product designer at one of our portfolio companies, honor , where he designed the future of home care. Before honor he was a founding product designer for Relastax and First Derm . Evan is an accomplished 3D artist and has exhibited around the world in New York, Tokyo, Paris, Valencia, Portugal, Berlin, Seoul, Art Basel Miami, and Scope Art Gallery.

rows.name: Faith Zehfuss
rows.bio: Faith is a member of the investment team focused on defense, manufacturing, supply chain and other emerging technologies. She is also actively involved with the 8VC Build program. Prior to 8VC, Faith was involved with multiple early stage startups in compliance, fintech, gaming, and agriculture across three continents. She graduated from Stanford University with a B.A. in International Relations and a minor in Mandarin, where she also pursued her Masters in International Policy at the Freeman-Spogli Institute, focusing on International Security. At Stanford, she launched the Gordian Knot Defense Innovation Scholar program, co-developed and taught a new course MS&E 299: Entrepreneurship Inside Government, and was involved in a robotics project for the Special Operations community.

rows.name: Francisco Gimenez
rows.bio: Francisco focuses on Bio-IT investments and Enterprise AI. Francisco previously was the Resident Data Scientist at Formation 8, where he worked with portfolio companies to strategize, prototype, and recruit for data products. He was the founder of Catenus Science, a data science consulting and recruiting firm that used an apprenticeship model to help early stage companies build data science teams. Francisco received his Ph.D. in Biomedical Informatics from Stanford , where he was a Ruth L. Kirchstein Fellow. His research focused on clinical decision support for Radiology, which won him the Martin Epstein award for best paper at the American Medical Informatics Association in 2014. He was the commencement speaker for the Stanford School of Medicine in 2015. He earned his BS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences from UC Berkeley while doing research in Parkinson’s disease at UCSF .

rows.name: Gabe Rosen
rows.bio: As Humanities Scholar in Residence, Gabe is responsible for the written word at 8VC, including announcements and publications, investor relations communications, and supporting portfolio and Build companies. Prior to joining 8VC, Gabe spent thirteen years at Palantir, initially as a member of the Defense team, followed by a variety of special projects, talent, corporate development, and government relations roles. He also had an infamous stint as the voice of Palantir’s early demo videos. Outside of work, Gabe is an avid open water swimmer, training year-round in the San Francisco Bay, and enjoys composing sonnets and officiating wedding ceremonies. Gabe holds a B.A. and M.A. from Stanford University .

rows.name: Ian Shannon
rows.bio: Ian Shannon is the firm’s general counsel and provides guidance to the 8VC team on investments, fund structuring, and compliance. Prior to joining 8VC, Ian was a partner and corporate counsel at Andreessen Horowitz . He began his legal career as a corporate associate in Cooley’s Palo Alto office. Ian received a J.D. from Boston College Law School and an A.B. in English from Princeton University .

rows.name: Jack Moshkovich
rows.bio: Jack is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on investing in enterprise software. Prior to joining 8VC Jack worked in McKinsey & Company ’s Moscow office, where he focused on strategic projects for both consumer and enterprise focused customers. Jack graduated from Stanford University , receiving his B.S. in Management Science & Engineering. Originally from Moscow, Russia, Jack has spent extensive time living in other countries, including five years in England prior to attending Stanford.

rows.name: Jack Roberson
rows.bio: Jack works with Stephen Condon, Joel Hemmert, Alyssa Hendricks and Madison McDonald in portfolio management and financial reporting for 8VC. Prior to joining 8VC, Jack worked at KPMG as an Audit Associate in Fort Worth, Texas, specializing in asset management and alternative investments. Jack graduated from Texas Tech University with a Bachelor's degree in Accounting and subsequently received his Masters in Accounting from Texas Christian University. Jack is a CPA and a member of the AICPA.

rows.name: Jake Medwell
rows.bio: Jake is a serial entrepreneur and investor. He is a co-founder of 8VC and leads 8VC’s logistics and transportation practice. Jake most recently co-founded Gallatin and Fabrion . Before that, he co-founded Terminal Logistics , a computer vision and AI company transforming supply chain and yard management. Earlier, he co-founded BATON , a logistics technology company that was acquired by Ryder Systems [NYSE:R] in 2022. Prior to his logistics ventures, Jake co-founded Humin [Acq. NYSE: IAC], a consumer mobile software company where he built the engineering team and led growth. Jake also co-founded The Kairos Society , where he sits on the Board of Directors. While in college, he founded Solé Bicycle Co. [Acq.] and grew it into an industry leader. Jake is an avid philanthropist, co-founding Operation Masks with partner Drew Oetting to help bring PPE to medical workers on the front line of the fight against COVID-19. Jake serves as an advisor and board member to a wide range of companies and nonprofits. Jake graduated from the University of Southern California in 2011, where he has been lecturing on entrepreneurship and technology for the last decade.

rows.name: James Piercy
rows.bio: James joins 8VC with 10+ years of talent experience spanning from large, mid size and early stage companies. With experience from companies like Google, Facebook & Instacart, James has built & scaled recruiting teams across engineering, product & design.His interest in 0 > 1 building, led him to join Tome, a Series A startup within the 8VC portfolio, as their first recruiter/head of talent. There he worked directly with the co-founders to build out their talent strategy and hiring processes from scratch. His excitement to work with innovative and passionate founders brought him to 8VC, where he's excited to help build the iconic companies of the future.

rows.name: Jane Commerford
rows.bio: Jane is 8VC’s Executive Assistant. She oversees daily office operations and ensures a smooth, welcoming, and well-organized environment for the team. Before joining 8VC, Jane worked as a preschool teacher, where she honed her communication skills, adaptability, and ability to manage many moving parts at once. Jane graduated from Purdue University in 2020 with a B.S. in Information Technology and a minor in Flute Performance.

rows.name: Jin-Young Kim
rows.bio: Jin-Young Kim is Partner and Head of Capital Formation at 8VC, where she leads the firm's business development, investor relations, and firm operations. Jin-Young was an early team member at Formation 8, playing a key role in building the organization. Before Formation 8, she worked at General Atlantic , a global growth equity firm, where she focused on investment opportunities in enterprise software. She began her career in technology investment banking at Morgan Stanley . Jin-Young received a B.A. in English Literature from Amherst College and an M.B.A. from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania . She lives in Menlo Park, California with her husband and two daughters.

rows.name: Joe Lonsdale
rows.bio: Joe Lonsdale is the Founder and Managing Partner at 8VC, an early-stage venture capital firm managing over $6 billion in capital. In 2003, he founded Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR), a global software company known for its work supporting US and its allies’ defense and intelligence. Since then, he has founded over a dozen prominent companies, including Addepar , a wealth management platform helping investors manage over $7 trillion, and OpenGov , the leading cloud software provider for local governments which recently sold for $1.8 billion. He continues to create and scale companies through the 8VC Build program. Joe was an early investor in Anduril , Oculus (acq. FB), Guardant Health (NASDAQ:GH), Oscar (NYSE:OSCR), Illumio , Wish (NASDAQ:WISH), JoyTunes , Blend (NYSE:BLND), Flexport , Joby Aviation (NYSE:JOBY), Orca Bio , Qualia , Synthego , RelateIQ (acq. CRM), Yugabyte , among many others. Joe and his wife Tayler are active in a variety of philanthropic and institutional pursuits. In 2018, they founded the nonpartisan Cicero Institute to fight for effective and accountable government. It has quickly grown into one of the most effective public policy organizations battling special interests, partnering with courageous leaders, and passing 175 bills across nearly 30 states. In 2021, Joe became the founding chairman of the board of the University of Austin (UATX) , a new university dedicated to restoring the pursuit of truth in higher education. He also sits on the board of the Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation & Institute . Joe, Tayler, and their six children live in Austin, TX.

rows.name: Joel Hemmert
rows.bio: Joel works with Stephen Condon, Alyssa Hendricks, and Madison McDonald in portfolio management and financial reporting for 8VC. Prior to joining 8VC, Joel was a Manager in PwC’s assurance practice in Austin, specializing in financial services.Joel graduated from the University of Texas at Austin with a Bachelor of Business Administration and a Master in Professional Accounting. He is a CPA and a member of the AICPA. ‍

rows.name: Justin Rose
rows.bio: Justin is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on aerospace, semiconductors, energy, and other frontier technologies. Prior to joining 8VC, Justin worked at SpaceX , where he wrote firmware for the Starlink constellation's inter-satellite links. Previously, he was a real estate and private equity analyst at A.G. Hill Partners , where he focused on energy and deep-tech investments. Justin graduated from Stanford University with a Bachelor's in Math and Physics (with Distinction; Phi Beta Kappa) and a Master's in Electrical Engineering. He is originally from Los Angeles, California.

rows.name: Karen White
rows.bio: Karen White is an Executive Partner at 8VC, working closely with CEOs and founders to scale their businesses, building on a decade as a key advisor to both 8VC and companies such as Addepar and OpenGov. Karen is also in the process of co-founding a new company within the 8VC platform. Karen has been a driving force behind several multi-billion-dollar companies, and brings a record of innovation, transformation and hypergrowth to 8VC. Karen was formerly CEO at RMS. Under her leadership, RMS became the world's leading catastrophic risk tech company, and was acquired by Moody's for $2 billion. She was named among Comparably’s 50 Best CEOs of 2020, alongside the CEOs of Zoom, Microsoft, Apple and Google. Prior to RMS, Karen was President and COO at Addepar, which supports over $5 trillion on its wealth management platform. Before Addepar, Karen was CEO and Chairman of enterprise SaaS company Syncplicity, leading it from seed stage to 30,000 customers and acquisition by EMC in three years. Previously, Karen was an executive at Solarwinds, a multi-billion dollar network management software company that successfully IPO’d in 2009. From 1993-2000, Karen worked for CEO Larry Ellison in various top executive roles at Oracle, driving explosive revenue and product growth as the Internet transformed global industry. During her tenure, Oracle’s revenue grew to $10 billion, profits increased nearly 65x, and valuation exceeded $150 billion.

rows.name: Kevin Niechen
rows.bio: Kevin is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on enterprise software. Prior to 8VC, Kevin worked on systems architecture research with Professor Dan Abadi at the University of Maryland to build new primitives for distributed databases. He worked on applied research in large-scale ML models at Airbnb AI Labs . He was an early engineer at Neeva , a search engine startup, where he worked on ranking and built their first indexing pipeline. Kevin graduated from the University of Maryland, where he competed in ACM-ICPC and created a class on reinforcement learning.

rows.name: Luke Bugbee
rows.bio: Luke is 8VC's Head of Design and Creative Director. He handles all things pertaining to 8VC's brand, website, messaging, and materials, though he spends the majority of his time partnering with 8VC portfolio companies to ensure a high bar of excellence for product design and brand. Luke also oversees the design for 8VC's Build and Fellowship programs, where he works with founders in the earliest days of their companies' inception, designing and building their first products and brands, and bringing them to market. As part of this program, Luke was the first designer at Epirus , Resilience , Esper , Luminary , Saronic , Fig-1 , TAP , Standard Metrics , and many other 8VC portfolio companies. Prior to joining 8VC, Luke was a designer for Camino . Before that, Luke spent 2 years as a designer for OpenGov . Luke is also an accomplished artist. His work has been featured by Lululemon Athletica , Adobe's Inspire Magazine , and Grafik Design Academy's yearly magazine, and his illustrations have appeared in the New York Times , WIRED , Business Insider , the Wall Street Journal , and other publications. Luke holds a B.S. in Business Marketing from The Master's University . ‍

rows.name: Luke Zane
rows.bio: As a Graphic Designer at 8VC, Luke Zane takes care of everything from one-off graphic requests to company rebrands for 8VC Build and Fellowship programs. Luke also takes care of portfolio company graphic needs in order to ensure their visual and design success. Luke started his design career by attending NNU in Idaho. After his time there he started a successful freelance business working for multiple advertising agencies in Boise, Idaho. Along the way he got to do work for Disney 's Toy Story, Blue Diamond Almonds , Micron and St. Luke’s Hospital . Shortly after his stint in the ad world he began doing work for startups and found his place helping new companies express their ideas and identities visually. Luke also moonlit as a muralist and has multiple pieces on display on the buildings of downtown Boise.

rows.name: Macenzie Walford
rows.bio: Macenzie works as an executive assistant supporting one of our Founding Partners at 8VC.She began her career working alongside the founder of Observe.AI , where she played a key role in supporting operations within the AI space. She later followed the same founder to Sanas , contributing to the early-stage growth of the company. Macenzie attended North Dakota State University (NDSU), where she developed a strong foundation that complements her professional expertise.

rows.name: Madison McDonald
rows.bio: Madison works on portfolio management and financial reporting for 8VC. Prior to joining 8VC, Madison worked at Deloitte as a Tax Consultant primarily in financial services in Houston, Texas. Madison graduated from the University of Texas at Austin with a BA in Economics and a Masters in Professional Accounting. She is a CPA and a member of the AICPA .

rows.name: Nichole Horton
rows.bio: Prior to joining 8VC, Nichole was a Senior Manager in PwC ’s assurance practice in New York, specializing in private equity and publicly traded real estate investment companies. Nichole also completed an international tour in the Investment Management practice in London, UK. Nichole graduated from the University of San Diego with a Bachelor of Arts in Accounting and a Master of Science in Accountancy and Financial Management. She is a CPA and member of the AICPA .

rows.name: Nick Dolik
rows.bio: Prior to joining 8VC Nick was Managing Director at TriplePoint Capital, a hybrid private credit and venture firm where he focused on debt and equity investments in venture-backed companies. Before that he helped build the venture lending and banking business at Signature Bank and led growth at the startup Nomad Financial. He began his career in structured credit at Goldman Sachs.

rows.name: Nick Penske
rows.bio: Prior to joining 8VC, Nick worked as an Associate at TRP Capital Partners. TRP is a private equity fund that invests in growth oriented businesses in the transportation sector. Prior to TRP, Nick worked at Hudson Pacific Properties, a West Coast based REIT that owns and operates sustainable office and studio space. Nick graduated from Cornell University in 2019 with a Major in Government. He is originally from Los Angeles and has spent time living in both Detroit and NYC.He is also a big racing fan and follows IndyCar, Nascar, and WEC.

rows.name: Robin Kaufman
rows.bio: Robin is the Director of Joe Lonsdale’s Executive Office. Robin started as Joe’s Executive Assistant at Addepar in 2011, and now spends the majority of her time at 8VC on the logistical operations of his daily life and travels. Robin has been supporting C-Level executives in various industries for over ten years, at such companies at Hotel Nikko , The Pacific Maritime Association , All Nippon Airlines , and Sumitomo-Mitsui Banking Corporation . Her philanthropy work focuses on alleviating local hunger issues at the San Francisco Food Bank . Robin received her B.A. from UCLA in Japanese Language and Linguistics.

rows.name: Rohan Bhargava
rows.bio: Rohan is an Associate, supporting 8VC's capital formation efforts, investor relations, and strategic initiatives. Prior to 8VC, Rohan worked at KKR, a global alternatives firm, where he focused on product strategy and capital formation across funds and co-investments in private equity, infrastructure, real estate, and credit. Rohan graduated from UC Berkeley in 2023 with a BS in Business Administration and a minor in Public Policy.

rows.name: Sallie Kim
rows.bio: Sallie Kim is the firm’s Chief Compliance Officer and Chief Regulatory Counsel. Prior to 8VC, Sallie served for over eight years at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Across three administrations, she led complex investigations, brought high-profile enforcement actions, and ultimately served as an Assistant Director. She developed deep regulatory expertise through matters involving public companies, private funds, and emerging technologies, often coordinating with other federal, state, and international regulators. Earlier in her career, Sallie was a litigator at Sidley Austin in San Francisco and Davis Polk in New York. Sallie received a J.D. from NYU School of Law and a B.A. from Yale University.

rows.name: Sebastian Caliri
rows.bio: Sebastian leads 8VC's healthcare team, investing in and building health-IT and health services businesses, alongside work in other sectors of the economy. Prior to 8VC, Sebastian led the healthcare division at Palantir where he helped numerous insurance, pharmaceutical, provider, and government clients solve their hardest data analysis problems. Outside of work, Sebastian is an avid reader , amateur artist, and loves long runs on the Embarcadero and backpacking in the Sierra. Sebastian completed a year of the MD program at Stanford University and holds a BS and MS, magna cum laude, in Molecular Biophysics & Biochemistry from Yale University .

rows.name: Seth Lieblich
rows.bio: Seth focuses on 8VC's Bio-IT investment area where he invests, builds and supports companies across areas such as therapeutics, tools, bio-infrastructures and broader applications of biology. He joined 8VC from Amgen ’s Business Development technology group, where he was responsible for search & evaluation and transactions for platform technologies across a number of therapeutic and functional areas. Seth was also responsible for strategic academic partnerships across all therapeutic and geographic areas. Prior to Amgen, Seth was at ZS Associates where he led teams engaging in market research, sales force design, and strategy. Prior to ZS Associates, Seth was co-founder and COO of Protomer Technologies , a Pasadena-based biologics startup. Seth received his Ph.D. in Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics from the California Institute of Technology and holds a B.S and M.S. in Biochemistry from Brandeis University .

rows.name: Stephanie Watkins
rows.bio: Stephanie works at 8VC as an Executive Assistant supporting Karen White.Prior to joining 8VC, Stephanie served as the Director of Executive Affairs at Haun Ventures as one of its founding employees. Previously, she has served roles with a16z in the early days of its crypto fund, Mithril Capital Management and Clarium Capital.Stephanie holds a B.A. in Sociology from San Francisco State University.

rows.name: Stephen Condon
rows.bio: Stephen is 8VC’s Chief Financial Officer. Prior to joining 8VC, Stephen served as a Senior Director at global investment firm, TPG Inc. (NASDAQ: TPG) with responsibility for finance, accounting and financial reporting for the firm’s private equity, public-company REIT, and SPAC businesses. He previously served as a Finance Director for Tradeweb Markets Inc. (NASDAQ: TW), a leading builder and operator of electronic fixed income, derivative, and ETF marketplaces. He received his MBA from Texas Christian University . Stephen is a Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants and is also a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants. He serves as a board member of the Children’s Medical Research Foundation (CMRF Inc.).

rows.name: Susan Liu
rows.bio: Susan is a member of the investment team, where she focuses on therapeutics, tools, bio-infrastructures and broader applications of biology. Prior to 8VC, Susan was a part of the Biotech investing team at Insight Partners. Before that, she was a Venture Investing Fellow at 5AM Ventures, focusing on therapeutics investing and venture creation. She did research at the Broad Institute in the Lander Lab, where she worked on stem cell reprogramming and differentiation. Susan graduated from Wellesley College and completed her PhD at Duke University in Computational Biology and Bioinformatics. She was a member of the Gersbach Lab at Duke, developing software and statistical modeling for scCRISPR screens. She grew up in China and Australia.

rows.name: Tyler Bates-Collier
rows.bio: Tyler Bates-Collier works as an Executive Assistant for 8VC. Prior to joining the 8VC team, she worked as an Executive Assistant with the Blue / Clinical Venture Funds at Sandbox Industries . Aside from managing day-to-day duties with the Operations team, Tyler fully supported the Clinical Venture Team and worked as a Project Manager with several of the firm's advisory groups. Tyler holds a BHA with honors in Health Administration from Texas State University-San Marcos . In her spare time, she enjoys listening to music in the live music capital of the world - Austin, Texas.

rows.name: Vero St Germain
rows.bio: Vero leads the talent and recruiting team serving 8VC and its portfolio companies. Over the last 10+ years, she has helped a broad array of technology companies recruit and retain talented individuals, leaders, and executives. Prior to joining 8VC, Veronique led recruiting at Terminal . Over the past 4 years, Veronique has supported the growth of over 45 San Francisco and New York startups. She has experience building and rolling out talent acquisition strategies. From process implementation to building a robust recruitment training program, Veronique has built and led teams of incredible recruiters, sourcers and coordinators to hire top technical talent throughout multiple countries. Veronique has spent the last decade partnering with startups, helping them build software engineering teams across Canada, US, and LATAM regions. Her passion to work with founders continues to grow and she is thrilled to work with 8VC and build a robust Talent Program to support many more companies in reaching their goals.

rows.name: Vivek Gopalan
rows.bio: Vivek is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on data & software infrastructure and horizontal B2B SaaS. He also spends time on the Build program starting and incubating companies. Prior to joining 8VC, Vivek was a software engineer on the core database group at 8VC portfolio company Yugabyte , building YugabyteDB, a high-performance distributed transactional database. Before that, he worked on machine learning pipelines for the Sales Intelligence team at Bloomberg . Vivek studied Computer Science and Statistics & Data Science at Yale . He wrote his thesis on decentralized databases. He is an avid F1 fan and an enjoyer of science fiction & fantasy, particularly Sanderson's Cosmere. He hails from Issaquah, Washington, and has spent time living in New York & various parts of Connecticut.

rows.name: Yurie Lee
rows.bio: Yurie is a member of the Investor Relations team at 8VC, where she supports Jin-Young Kim across capital formation, LP relationships, and strategic initiatives. She combines operational leadership with executive support to translate vision into execution and expand capacity for leadership. Prior to 8VC, Yurie supported the investment team at Emergence Capital and worked as an Executive Assistant at DivcoWest and Athleta . She spent nine years leading teams in retail operations and management, including as Head of Operations at bkr and General Manager for Gap stores in San Francisco. Yurie is originally from New Jersey and currently lives in Oakland, California. In her free time, she enjoys taking long runs and walks on local trails.

rows.name: Zach White
rows.bio: As a Venture Partner at 8VC, Zach focuses on sourcing compelling investment opportunities and growing the 8VC platform through content, events, and community. He works closely with the 8VC Build program, providing operational support to new companies being incubated through the platform. Zach also helps lead 8VC’s defense investment strategy, identifying and supporting companies tackling critical national security challenges. Before joining 8VC, Zach spent four years helping run Sinai Ventures, a $100 million stage- and sector-agnostic fund. Zach holds a B.A. in Economics from New York University. ‍

team.name: Adrienne Alexander
team.bio: Adrienne supports a founding partner at 8VC. Prior to joining 8VC, Adrienne supported the co-head of the Endeavor Fund at Vista Equity Partners. Adrienne graduated from the University of Texas, receiving her B.A. in finance and her M.S. in clinical therapy.

team.name: Alex Kolicich
team.bio: Alex Kolicich focuses on IT and Bio-IT investments. Prior to joining 8VC, Alex was a Partner at Formation 8. Alex also worked with Peter Thiel as a Principal at Mithril Capital Management , a growth-stage venture fund, where he helped lead investments in AppDirect , C2FO and Helion Energy . Preceding his venture career, Alex worked as engineer and early-product advisor at Clarium , Palantir , and Google . He was an early member of the Clarium Capital quantitative engineering team (with Joe Lonsdale) and close advisor/collaborator with the early Palantir team; advising on product design and contributing to the product. At Google Research, Alex worked on Google Street-Views before and during launch. Preceding Street-Views, also at Google, he worked on the development and launch of the Google Checkout product.

team.name: Alex McLane
team.bio: Alex is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on AI application layer software and robotics. Prior to 8VC, Alex worked at the Yale Endowment and chaired a debating society for political and moral philosophy at Yale. He graduated magna cum laude from Yale with a Bachelor's in Math and Philosophy. Originally from Los Angeles, he spent much of his childhood in Hong Kong and Singapore.

team.name: Alex Moore
team.bio: Alex Moore runs Defense for 8VC and incubates companies through 8VC’s Build Program. Prior to joining 8VC Alex was a startup operator for 12 years. Alex was the 1st employee of Palantir Technologies. Alex currently sits on boards for Palantir, Saronic, Epirus, Chaos, Gallatin, CX2, iCOMAT and Terra.

team.name: Asanka Jayasuriya
team.bio: Asanka Jayasuriya is the CTO at 8VC. He is an accomplished engineering and product leader with 20+ years of experience in the cloud. He has a strong background in enterprise SaaS, PLG products, infrastructure, and security. Notably, he served as CTO and SVP of Engineering at SailPoint , leading their successful transition to the cloud and successful exit event. He also held senior leadership roles at InVision , Atlassian , and Amazon , driving growth, operational excellence, and innovation. At 8VC, Asanka works with the entrepreneurs and leaders in our portfolio as a virtual CTO supporting their growth.

team.name: Audrey Abbott
team.bio: Audrey is 8VC's Event Manager. She spearheads all internal and external events for the company. Her goal is to continue 8VC’s history of creating memorable high-profile events. Prior to joining 8VC, she worked in Events at the Texas Rangers Baseball Team and with the Jonas Brothers. Audrey graduated from the University of Southern California with a B.A. in Music Industry and a Political Science minor in 2020.

team.name: Ava Eitzen
team.bio: Ava is a member of 8VC's talent team. Prior to 8VC, Ava spent six years as an external recruiter for early stage startups, as well as organizations such as Palantir and Founders Fund . Ava received her Bachelors of Science from UC Davis . She is an active private pilot, and grew up in the U.S. Virgin Islands. She now lives in the San Francisco Bay Area.

team.name: Bela Becerra
team.bio: Bela Becerra is a member of the 8VC investment team, where she focuses on the firm's early-stage practice and build initiatives. She also partners with portfolio companies on talent and media strategy. She leads the Emerging Builders community to foster the next generation of the most ambitious entrepreneurs and engineers across SF, NY, and beyond. Bela holds a BA in Economics from Stanford University and is originally from Los Angeles.

team.name: Caroline Haun
team.bio: Caroline is Operations Director at 8VC. Prior to 8VC, Caroline managed operations for Formation 8. Prior to Formation 8, she worked at Highbridge Capital , in New York, as a Client Services professional specializing in loan-focused funds. Caroline began her career at San Francisco based hedge fund, PFM , L.P. as a research assistant focused on the Healthcare sector. Caroline received her B.S. in Business Administration with a concentration in Finance from The University of the Pacific .

team.name: Damon Lim
team.bio: As IT Director at 8VC, Damon enables friction-free productivity and best-in-class security through the application of technology and modern IT concepts and practices. Prior to 8VC, Damon led IT for 4 tech startups ( Palantir , Collective Health , Kandji , and Enkata) and was introduced to the venture space as Director of IT for Next47 . Damon is a graduate of San Francisco State University , where he received his bachelor’s degree in business administration.

team.name: Denise Mendez
team.bio: For the past three years, I was with SNH Capital Partners , a Private Equity firm, most recently as Office Manager. Aside from managing day-to-day operations, I supported cross functional teams from marketing, business development and real estate ensuring operational and service excellence. Prior to that, I have a strong background in luxury hospitality as well as food and beverage.

team.name: Deny Khoung
team.bio: Deny partners with 8VC's portfolio companies, adding value through design mentorship, hiring, product feedback, and being a conduit to help teams overcome design challenges. He also helps to drive the firm's design initiatives forward. Deny co-founded Standard Metrics , a financial collaboration platform for founders and their investors. Previously, Deny founded Whitespace, a designer accelerator helping early-stage startups ramp their design teams. Prior to that, he was a Designer-in-Residence at Formation 8 and a Creative Director at Zanbato , a fintech company focused on bringing efficiency to private capital markets. Deny has a BFA in Graphic Design and BFA in Photography from San Jose State University where he also served as an adjunct design lecturer. Deny serves as an advisor to startups including Standard Metrics, Affinity , and Esper .

team.name: Drew Oetting
team.bio: Drew is a founding partner of 8VC. He focuses on investments across various stage and sectors including vertical software, health delivery, and biomanufacturing. He is also a founding Board Director of Affinity Technologies, an early stage enterprise software company. Previously Drew was a partner at Formation 8. Before that he served as Chief of Staff to Joe Lonsdale. Drew serves on the Competitiveness Council for Cerberus Capital Management . He is also a Trustee of LivingOnOne , a non-profit impact production studio; WeAreThorn , a NGO which leverages technology to eliminate child trafficking; and the Claremont McKenna College Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship .

team.name: Erica Sun
team.bio: Erica Sun is the firm’s associate general counsel and provides guidance to the 8VC team on investments, exits, corporate governance and portfolio counseling. Prior to 8VC, Erica was a senior associate in Fenwick's San Francisco office, representing emerging companies from formation through exit and their investors, and advised on M&A transactions at Kirkland & Ellis. Erica received a J.D. from University of California, Berkeley, School of Law, and an A.B. in Neuroscience with High Honors from Dartmouth College.

team.name: Evan Pun
team.bio: Evan is a product designer and a 3D artist. He works with 8VC’s portfolio companies to design the next generation of products and brands. Prior to joining 8VC Evan was a staff product designer at one of our portfolio companies, honor , where he designed the future of home care. Before honor he was a founding product designer for Relastax and First Derm . Evan is an accomplished 3D artist and has exhibited around the world in New York, Tokyo, Paris, Valencia, Portugal, Berlin, Seoul, Art Basel Miami, and Scope Art Gallery.

team.name: Faith Zehfuss
team.bio: Faith is a member of the investment team focused on defense, manufacturing, supply chain and other emerging technologies. She is also actively involved with the 8VC Build program. Prior to 8VC, Faith was involved with multiple early stage startups in compliance, fintech, gaming, and agriculture across three continents. She graduated from Stanford University with a B.A. in International Relations and a minor in Mandarin, where she also pursued her Masters in International Policy at the Freeman-Spogli Institute, focusing on International Security. At Stanford, she launched the Gordian Knot Defense Innovation Scholar program, co-developed and taught a new course MS&E 299: Entrepreneurship Inside Government, and was involved in a robotics project for the Special Operations community.

team.name: Francisco Gimenez
team.bio: Francisco focuses on Bio-IT investments and Enterprise AI. Francisco previously was the Resident Data Scientist at Formation 8, where he worked with portfolio companies to strategize, prototype, and recruit for data products. He was the founder of Catenus Science, a data science consulting and recruiting firm that used an apprenticeship model to help early stage companies build data science teams. Francisco received his Ph.D. in Biomedical Informatics from Stanford , where he was a Ruth L. Kirchstein Fellow. His research focused on clinical decision support for Radiology, which won him the Martin Epstein award for best paper at the American Medical Informatics Association in 2014. He was the commencement speaker for the Stanford School of Medicine in 2015. He earned his BS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences from UC Berkeley while doing research in Parkinson’s disease at UCSF .

team.name: Gabe Rosen
team.bio: As Humanities Scholar in Residence, Gabe is responsible for the written word at 8VC, including announcements and publications, investor relations communications, and supporting portfolio and Build companies. Prior to joining 8VC, Gabe spent thirteen years at Palantir, initially as a member of the Defense team, followed by a variety of special projects, talent, corporate development, and government relations roles. He also had an infamous stint as the voice of Palantir’s early demo videos. Outside of work, Gabe is an avid open water swimmer, training year-round in the San Francisco Bay, and enjoys composing sonnets and officiating wedding ceremonies. Gabe holds a B.A. and M.A. from Stanford University .

team.name: Ian Shannon
team.bio: Ian Shannon is the firm’s general counsel and provides guidance to the 8VC team on investments, fund structuring, and compliance. Prior to joining 8VC, Ian was a partner and corporate counsel at Andreessen Horowitz . He began his legal career as a corporate associate in Cooley’s Palo Alto office. Ian received a J.D. from Boston College Law School and an A.B. in English from Princeton University .

team.name: Jack Moshkovich
team.bio: Jack is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on investing in enterprise software. Prior to joining 8VC Jack worked in McKinsey & Company ’s Moscow office, where he focused on strategic projects for both consumer and enterprise focused customers. Jack graduated from Stanford University , receiving his B.S. in Management Science & Engineering. Originally from Moscow, Russia, Jack has spent extensive time living in other countries, including five years in England prior to attending Stanford.

team.name: Jack Roberson
team.bio: Jack works with Stephen Condon, Joel Hemmert, Alyssa Hendricks and Madison McDonald in portfolio management and financial reporting for 8VC. Prior to joining 8VC, Jack worked at KPMG as an Audit Associate in Fort Worth, Texas, specializing in asset management and alternative investments. Jack graduated from Texas Tech University with a Bachelor's degree in Accounting and subsequently received his Masters in Accounting from Texas Christian University. Jack is a CPA and a member of the AICPA.

team.name: Jake Medwell
team.bio: Jake is a serial entrepreneur and investor. He is a co-founder of 8VC and leads 8VC’s logistics and transportation practice. Jake most recently co-founded Gallatin and Fabrion . Before that, he co-founded Terminal Logistics , a computer vision and AI company transforming supply chain and yard management. Earlier, he co-founded BATON , a logistics technology company that was acquired by Ryder Systems [NYSE:R] in 2022. Prior to his logistics ventures, Jake co-founded Humin [Acq. NYSE: IAC], a consumer mobile software company where he built the engineering team and led growth. Jake also co-founded The Kairos Society , where he sits on the Board of Directors. While in college, he founded Solé Bicycle Co. [Acq.] and grew it into an industry leader. Jake is an avid philanthropist, co-founding Operation Masks with partner Drew Oetting to help bring PPE to medical workers on the front line of the fight against COVID-19. Jake serves as an advisor and board member to a wide range of companies and nonprofits. Jake graduated from the University of Southern California in 2011, where he has been lecturing on entrepreneurship and technology for the last decade.

team.name: James Piercy
team.bio: James joins 8VC with 10+ years of talent experience spanning from large, mid size and early stage companies. With experience from companies like Google, Facebook & Instacart, James has built & scaled recruiting teams across engineering, product & design.His interest in 0 > 1 building, led him to join Tome, a Series A startup within the 8VC portfolio, as their first recruiter/head of talent. There he worked directly with the co-founders to build out their talent strategy and hiring processes from scratch. His excitement to work with innovative and passionate founders brought him to 8VC, where he's excited to help build the iconic companies of the future.

team.name: Jane Commerford
team.bio: Jane is 8VC’s Executive Assistant. She oversees daily office operations and ensures a smooth, welcoming, and well-organized environment for the team. Before joining 8VC, Jane worked as a preschool teacher, where she honed her communication skills, adaptability, and ability to manage many moving parts at once. Jane graduated from Purdue University in 2020 with a B.S. in Information Technology and a minor in Flute Performance.

team.name: Jin-Young Kim
team.bio: Jin-Young Kim is Partner and Head of Capital Formation at 8VC, where she leads the firm's business development, investor relations, and firm operations. Jin-Young was an early team member at Formation 8, playing a key role in building the organization. Before Formation 8, she worked at General Atlantic , a global growth equity firm, where she focused on investment opportunities in enterprise software. She began her career in technology investment banking at Morgan Stanley . Jin-Young received a B.A. in English Literature from Amherst College and an M.B.A. from The Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania . She lives in Menlo Park, California with her husband and two daughters.

team.name: Joe Lonsdale
team.bio: Joe Lonsdale is the Founder and Managing Partner at 8VC, an early-stage venture capital firm managing over $6 billion in capital. In 2003, he founded Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR), a global software company known for its work supporting US and its allies’ defense and intelligence. Since then, he has founded over a dozen prominent companies, including Addepar , a wealth management platform helping investors manage over $7 trillion, and OpenGov , the leading cloud software provider for local governments which recently sold for $1.8 billion. He continues to create and scale companies through the 8VC Build program. Joe was an early investor in Anduril , Oculus (acq. FB), Guardant Health (NASDAQ:GH), Oscar (NYSE:OSCR), Illumio , Wish (NASDAQ:WISH), JoyTunes , Blend (NYSE:BLND), Flexport , Joby Aviation (NYSE:JOBY), Orca Bio , Qualia , Synthego , RelateIQ (acq. CRM), Yugabyte , among many others. Joe and his wife Tayler are active in a variety of philanthropic and institutional pursuits. In 2018, they founded the nonpartisan Cicero Institute to fight for effective and accountable government. It has quickly grown into one of the most effective public policy organizations battling special interests, partnering with courageous leaders, and passing 175 bills across nearly 30 states. In 2021, Joe became the founding chairman of the board of the University of Austin (UATX) , a new university dedicated to restoring the pursuit of truth in higher education. He also sits on the board of the Ronald Reagan Presidential Foundation & Institute . Joe, Tayler, and their six children live in Austin, TX.

team.name: Joel Hemmert
team.bio: Joel works with Stephen Condon, Alyssa Hendricks, and Madison McDonald in portfolio management and financial reporting for 8VC. Prior to joining 8VC, Joel was a Manager in PwC’s assurance practice in Austin, specializing in financial services.Joel graduated from the University of Texas at Austin with a Bachelor of Business Administration and a Master in Professional Accounting. He is a CPA and a member of the AICPA. ‍

team.name: Justin Rose
team.bio: Justin is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on aerospace, semiconductors, energy, and other frontier technologies. Prior to joining 8VC, Justin worked at SpaceX , where he wrote firmware for the Starlink constellation's inter-satellite links. Previously, he was a real estate and private equity analyst at A.G. Hill Partners , where he focused on energy and deep-tech investments. Justin graduated from Stanford University with a Bachelor's in Math and Physics (with Distinction; Phi Beta Kappa) and a Master's in Electrical Engineering. He is originally from Los Angeles, California.

team.name: Karen White
team.bio: Karen White is an Executive Partner at 8VC, working closely with CEOs and founders to scale their businesses, building on a decade as a key advisor to both 8VC and companies such as Addepar and OpenGov. Karen is also in the process of co-founding a new company within the 8VC platform. Karen has been a driving force behind several multi-billion-dollar companies, and brings a record of innovation, transformation and hypergrowth to 8VC. Karen was formerly CEO at RMS. Under her leadership, RMS became the world's leading catastrophic risk tech company, and was acquired by Moody's for $2 billion. She was named among Comparably’s 50 Best CEOs of 2020, alongside the CEOs of Zoom, Microsoft, Apple and Google. Prior to RMS, Karen was President and COO at Addepar, which supports over $5 trillion on its wealth management platform. Before Addepar, Karen was CEO and Chairman of enterprise SaaS company Syncplicity, leading it from seed stage to 30,000 customers and acquisition by EMC in three years. Previously, Karen was an executive at Solarwinds, a multi-billion dollar network management software company that successfully IPO’d in 2009. From 1993-2000, Karen worked for CEO Larry Ellison in various top executive roles at Oracle, driving explosive revenue and product growth as the Internet transformed global industry. During her tenure, Oracle’s revenue grew to $10 billion, profits increased nearly 65x, and valuation exceeded $150 billion.

team.name: Kevin Niechen
team.bio: Kevin is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on enterprise software. Prior to 8VC, Kevin worked on systems architecture research with Professor Dan Abadi at the University of Maryland to build new primitives for distributed databases. He worked on applied research in large-scale ML models at Airbnb AI Labs . He was an early engineer at Neeva , a search engine startup, where he worked on ranking and built their first indexing pipeline. Kevin graduated from the University of Maryland, where he competed in ACM-ICPC and created a class on reinforcement learning.

team.name: Luke Bugbee
team.bio: Luke is 8VC's Head of Design and Creative Director. He handles all things pertaining to 8VC's brand, website, messaging, and materials, though he spends the majority of his time partnering with 8VC portfolio companies to ensure a high bar of excellence for product design and brand. Luke also oversees the design for 8VC's Build and Fellowship programs, where he works with founders in the earliest days of their companies' inception, designing and building their first products and brands, and bringing them to market. As part of this program, Luke was the first designer at Epirus , Resilience , Esper , Luminary , Saronic , Fig-1 , TAP , Standard Metrics , and many other 8VC portfolio companies. Prior to joining 8VC, Luke was a designer for Camino . Before that, Luke spent 2 years as a designer for OpenGov . Luke is also an accomplished artist. His work has been featured by Lululemon Athletica , Adobe's Inspire Magazine , and Grafik Design Academy's yearly magazine, and his illustrations have appeared in the New York Times , WIRED , Business Insider , the Wall Street Journal , and other publications. Luke holds a B.S. in Business Marketing from The Master's University . ‍

team.name: Luke Zane
team.bio: As a Graphic Designer at 8VC, Luke Zane takes care of everything from one-off graphic requests to company rebrands for 8VC Build and Fellowship programs. Luke also takes care of portfolio company graphic needs in order to ensure their visual and design success. Luke started his design career by attending NNU in Idaho. After his time there he started a successful freelance business working for multiple advertising agencies in Boise, Idaho. Along the way he got to do work for Disney 's Toy Story, Blue Diamond Almonds , Micron and St. Luke’s Hospital . Shortly after his stint in the ad world he began doing work for startups and found his place helping new companies express their ideas and identities visually. Luke also moonlit as a muralist and has multiple pieces on display on the buildings of downtown Boise.

team.name: Macenzie Walford
team.bio: Macenzie works as an executive assistant supporting one of our Founding Partners at 8VC.She began her career working alongside the founder of Observe.AI , where she played a key role in supporting operations within the AI space. She later followed the same founder to Sanas , contributing to the early-stage growth of the company. Macenzie attended North Dakota State University (NDSU), where she developed a strong foundation that complements her professional expertise.

team.name: Madison McDonald
team.bio: Madison works on portfolio management and financial reporting for 8VC. Prior to joining 8VC, Madison worked at Deloitte as a Tax Consultant primarily in financial services in Houston, Texas. Madison graduated from the University of Texas at Austin with a BA in Economics and a Masters in Professional Accounting. She is a CPA and a member of the AICPA .

team.name: Nichole Horton
team.bio: Prior to joining 8VC, Nichole was a Senior Manager in PwC ’s assurance practice in New York, specializing in private equity and publicly traded real estate investment companies. Nichole also completed an international tour in the Investment Management practice in London, UK. Nichole graduated from the University of San Diego with a Bachelor of Arts in Accounting and a Master of Science in Accountancy and Financial Management. She is a CPA and member of the AICPA .

team.name: Nick Dolik
team.bio: Prior to joining 8VC Nick was Managing Director at TriplePoint Capital, a hybrid private credit and venture firm where he focused on debt and equity investments in venture-backed companies. Before that he helped build the venture lending and banking business at Signature Bank and led growth at the startup Nomad Financial. He began his career in structured credit at Goldman Sachs.

team.name: Nick Penske
team.bio: Prior to joining 8VC, Nick worked as an Associate at TRP Capital Partners. TRP is a private equity fund that invests in growth oriented businesses in the transportation sector. Prior to TRP, Nick worked at Hudson Pacific Properties, a West Coast based REIT that owns and operates sustainable office and studio space. Nick graduated from Cornell University in 2019 with a Major in Government. He is originally from Los Angeles and has spent time living in both Detroit and NYC.He is also a big racing fan and follows IndyCar, Nascar, and WEC.

team.name: Robin Kaufman
team.bio: Robin is the Director of Joe Lonsdale’s Executive Office. Robin started as Joe’s Executive Assistant at Addepar in 2011, and now spends the majority of her time at 8VC on the logistical operations of his daily life and travels. Robin has been supporting C-Level executives in various industries for over ten years, at such companies at Hotel Nikko , The Pacific Maritime Association , All Nippon Airlines , and Sumitomo-Mitsui Banking Corporation . Her philanthropy work focuses on alleviating local hunger issues at the San Francisco Food Bank . Robin received her B.A. from UCLA in Japanese Language and Linguistics.

team.name: Rohan Bhargava
team.bio: Rohan is an Associate, supporting 8VC's capital formation efforts, investor relations, and strategic initiatives. Prior to 8VC, Rohan worked at KKR, a global alternatives firm, where he focused on product strategy and capital formation across funds and co-investments in private equity, infrastructure, real estate, and credit. Rohan graduated from UC Berkeley in 2023 with a BS in Business Administration and a minor in Public Policy.

team.name: Sallie Kim
team.bio: Sallie Kim is the firm’s Chief Compliance Officer and Chief Regulatory Counsel. Prior to 8VC, Sallie served for over eight years at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. Across three administrations, she led complex investigations, brought high-profile enforcement actions, and ultimately served as an Assistant Director. She developed deep regulatory expertise through matters involving public companies, private funds, and emerging technologies, often coordinating with other federal, state, and international regulators. Earlier in her career, Sallie was a litigator at Sidley Austin in San Francisco and Davis Polk in New York. Sallie received a J.D. from NYU School of Law and a B.A. from Yale University.

team.name: Sebastian Caliri
team.bio: Sebastian leads 8VC's healthcare team, investing in and building health-IT and health services businesses, alongside work in other sectors of the economy. Prior to 8VC, Sebastian led the healthcare division at Palantir where he helped numerous insurance, pharmaceutical, provider, and government clients solve their hardest data analysis problems. Outside of work, Sebastian is an avid reader , amateur artist, and loves long runs on the Embarcadero and backpacking in the Sierra. Sebastian completed a year of the MD program at Stanford University and holds a BS and MS, magna cum laude, in Molecular Biophysics & Biochemistry from Yale University .

team.name: Seth Lieblich
team.bio: Seth focuses on 8VC's Bio-IT investment area where he invests, builds and supports companies across areas such as therapeutics, tools, bio-infrastructures and broader applications of biology. He joined 8VC from Amgen ’s Business Development technology group, where he was responsible for search & evaluation and transactions for platform technologies across a number of therapeutic and functional areas. Seth was also responsible for strategic academic partnerships across all therapeutic and geographic areas. Prior to Amgen, Seth was at ZS Associates where he led teams engaging in market research, sales force design, and strategy. Prior to ZS Associates, Seth was co-founder and COO of Protomer Technologies , a Pasadena-based biologics startup. Seth received his Ph.D. in Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics from the California Institute of Technology and holds a B.S and M.S. in Biochemistry from Brandeis University .

team.name: Stephanie Watkins
team.bio: Stephanie works at 8VC as an Executive Assistant supporting Karen White.Prior to joining 8VC, Stephanie served as the Director of Executive Affairs at Haun Ventures as one of its founding employees. Previously, she has served roles with a16z in the early days of its crypto fund, Mithril Capital Management and Clarium Capital.Stephanie holds a B.A. in Sociology from San Francisco State University.

team.name: Stephen Condon
team.bio: Stephen is 8VC’s Chief Financial Officer. Prior to joining 8VC, Stephen served as a Senior Director at global investment firm, TPG Inc. (NASDAQ: TPG) with responsibility for finance, accounting and financial reporting for the firm’s private equity, public-company REIT, and SPAC businesses. He previously served as a Finance Director for Tradeweb Markets Inc. (NASDAQ: TW), a leading builder and operator of electronic fixed income, derivative, and ETF marketplaces. He received his MBA from Texas Christian University . Stephen is a Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants and is also a member of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants. He serves as a board member of the Children’s Medical Research Foundation (CMRF Inc.).

team.name: Susan Liu
team.bio: Susan is a member of the investment team, where she focuses on therapeutics, tools, bio-infrastructures and broader applications of biology. Prior to 8VC, Susan was a part of the Biotech investing team at Insight Partners. Before that, she was a Venture Investing Fellow at 5AM Ventures, focusing on therapeutics investing and venture creation. She did research at the Broad Institute in the Lander Lab, where she worked on stem cell reprogramming and differentiation. Susan graduated from Wellesley College and completed her PhD at Duke University in Computational Biology and Bioinformatics. She was a member of the Gersbach Lab at Duke, developing software and statistical modeling for scCRISPR screens. She grew up in China and Australia.

team.name: Tyler Bates-Collier
team.bio: Tyler Bates-Collier works as an Executive Assistant for 8VC. Prior to joining the 8VC team, she worked as an Executive Assistant with the Blue / Clinical Venture Funds at Sandbox Industries . Aside from managing day-to-day duties with the Operations team, Tyler fully supported the Clinical Venture Team and worked as a Project Manager with several of the firm's advisory groups. Tyler holds a BHA with honors in Health Administration from Texas State University-San Marcos . In her spare time, she enjoys listening to music in the live music capital of the world - Austin, Texas.

team.name: Vero St Germain
team.bio: Vero leads the talent and recruiting team serving 8VC and its portfolio companies. Over the last 10+ years, she has helped a broad array of technology companies recruit and retain talented individuals, leaders, and executives. Prior to joining 8VC, Veronique led recruiting at Terminal . Over the past 4 years, Veronique has supported the growth of over 45 San Francisco and New York startups. She has experience building and rolling out talent acquisition strategies. From process implementation to building a robust recruitment training program, Veronique has built and led teams of incredible recruiters, sourcers and coordinators to hire top technical talent throughout multiple countries. Veronique has spent the last decade partnering with startups, helping them build software engineering teams across Canada, US, and LATAM regions. Her passion to work with founders continues to grow and she is thrilled to work with 8VC and build a robust Talent Program to support many more companies in reaching their goals.

team.name: Vivek Gopalan
team.bio: Vivek is a member of the investment team, where he focuses on data & software infrastructure and horizontal B2B SaaS. He also spends time on the Build program starting and incubating companies. Prior to joining 8VC, Vivek was a software engineer on the core database group at 8VC portfolio company Yugabyte , building YugabyteDB, a high-performance distributed transactional database. Before that, he worked on machine learning pipelines for the Sales Intelligence team at Bloomberg . Vivek studied Computer Science and Statistics & Data Science at Yale . He wrote his thesis on decentralized databases. He is an avid F1 fan and an enjoyer of science fiction & fantasy, particularly Sanderson's Cosmere. He hails from Issaquah, Washington, and has spent time living in New York & various parts of Connecticut.

team.name: Yurie Lee
team.bio: Yurie is a member of the Investor Relations team at 8VC, where she supports Jin-Young Kim across capital formation, LP relationships, and strategic initiatives. She combines operational leadership with executive support to translate vision into execution and expand capacity for leadership. Prior to 8VC, Yurie supported the investment team at Emergence Capital and worked as an Executive Assistant at DivcoWest and Athleta . She spent nine years leading teams in retail operations and management, including as Head of Operations at bkr and General Manager for Gap stores in San Francisco. Yurie is originally from New Jersey and currently lives in Oakland, California. In her free time, she enjoys taking long runs and walks on local trails.

team.name: Zach White
team.bio: As a Venture Partner at 8VC, Zach focuses on sourcing compelling investment opportunities and growing the 8VC platform through content, events, and community. He works closely with the 8VC Build program, providing operational support to new companies being incubated through the platform. Zach also helps lead 8VC’s defense investment strategy, identifying and supporting companies tackling critical national security challenges. Before joining 8VC, Zach spent four years helping run Sinai Ventures, a $100 million stage- and sector-agnostic fund. Zach holds a B.A. in Economics from New York University. ‍
